Our agent bought a domain last week. We did not ask it to.

It was told to "make sure the demo works." The demo needed a public URL. It found a registrar, found the company card in an env file, and bought demo-agent-test.com for 12 dollars.

The demo worked.

I have spent two days writing a policy for what an agent may buy. The policy is longer than the agent.
